title: Tactical perception view
description: What one side knows under fog of war at an AI-controlled activation. Built by tactical/core, passed to that side's controller as plain data: decide(view, rng) gets no query functions; path, line-of-sight and shot previews are precomputed in allowedActions (TAI-001). Spec: TAI-001, TAI-002, TAI-004, TAI-005, TAI-006, TAI-008, TAI-012, TAI-013, TAI-014, TAC-001, TAC-028, TAC-035, TAC-037, TAC-094, TAC-095.

doctrine.description: One doctrine per side, from the tactical map request sides[].doctrine (TAI-015)

activeUnit.description: Unit to act, or null when the side chooses whom to activate (answered by activate or pass, TAI-002)

squad.description: Every unit of the side that entered the battle, dead and gone ones included (TAI-004, TAI-009; spec choice)

zoneHp.description: zone → {hp, max}; max per TAC-057 (survival HP share, TAI-008; spec choice)

activeWeapon.description: Equipment slot of the weapon in hand (TAC-042, TAI-010)

equipment.description: Slot → item instance (TAI-004; slots as the tactical map request units[].equipment)

role.description: TAI-014: the role from squadPlan.roles, null while none is assigned; callReinforcements is OPTIONAL (later build) and never assigned until built

rank.description: From the tactical map request; sets the squad leader (TAI-013, TAC-094)

morale.description: Battle morale (TAC-095) plus the Leadership bonus while the leader is alive (TAC-094); survival input (TAI-008)

weaponJammed.description: TAC-083: the active weapon is jammed (clearJam)

outOfAction.description: Dead or left the map (TAC-038); wounded units never (TAI-009)

leftMap.description: Left the map at an exit (TAC-038); outOfAction is then true too

slot.description: Equipment slot it is carried in (reload.sourceSlot)

squadMorale.description: Average battle morale of the side's units on the map, without the Leadership bonus (TAC-095, TAI-004)

rejection.description: TAI-005: on a retry call, the command TAC rejected last in this activation and why; null otherwise

reason.description: Short reason code, e.g. notEnoughAp, noLineOfSight, invalidPath (spec choice: free string)

position.description: Current position while visibleNow, else last seen or heard

visibleGear.description: What the player would see: weaponType, helmetClass, armourClass (TAI-004)

knownNeutrals.description: Known units of the neutral side whose faction is not hostile to the viewing side (TAC-001); once hostile to it, they are listed in knownEnemies instead. Same last-known rule as knownEnemies (TAI-004)

position.description: Current position while visibleNow, else last seen or heard

contents.description: Only once searched by the side (TAC-070)
Only once searched by the side (TAC-070)

allowedActions.description: Precomputed answers the player UI would show (TAI-001, TAI-004): legal command types for the active unit with AP costs, path previews and shot previews. With activeUnit null: one activate entry per unit that may be activated (stamina >= activationCost, TAC-005, TAC-008), plus one pass entry

unit.description: activate: a unit that may be activated now

reachable.description: move: tiles with the previewed path, its AP cost and AP left (TAC-037); a move command may name only the tile, TAC then follows this path (TAI-005)

path.description: Tiles from the first step to tile

targets.description: shoot / throwGrenade: targets in line of sight with the shot preview (TAC-046)

concealed.description: TAC-046 / TAC-082: target concealed; hitChance is the best case (unshifted cone)

battleGoal.description: The active unit's goal: its own from the request, else its side's (TAI-009, TAI-018)

goal.description: As sent; TAC never sets retreat, the AI derives it (TAI-009)

objectives.description: Tactical-map objectives of the battle known to the side (TAC-076)

coverEdges.description: Cover per tile edge, n e s w (TAC-035)

doors.description: edge (n e s w) → door state (TAC-084)

squadPlan.description: TAI-012, TAI-013 (spec choice): stored by TAC, changed only by a setPlan write from the current leader

leader.description: Current squad leader (TAC-094), set by TAC

setBy.description: Unit whose setPlan write made this plan

intent.description: AI-owned plan content; TAC stores it without interpreting it

blackboard.description: Squad requests and claims (TAI-012, spec choice)

type.description: e.g. suppress, coverSector, reinforce (AI-defined; TAC does not interpret)

target.description: Unit ID, e.g. the unit to suppress

untilTurn.description: Last turn it is valid; TAC drops it after that
Last turn it is valid; TAC drops it after that
